facts.fact: disputed_amount is the part of the charge in dispute: the overcharge (charged minus expected) for incorrect_amount, the cash not received for atm_cash_discrepancy, the amount not credited for atm_deposit_not_credited, and the whole charge for the other categories
facts.passage: derived: doc 031 arg 8 'The dollar amount being disputed' with the category definitions 'Charged different amount than expected', 'ATM dispensed wrong amount or no cash', 'ATM deposit not reflected in account'

facts.fact: customer_max_liability_amount follows the Regulation E tier counted from the statement date that shows the charge (within 2 business days of the statement: 50; within 60 days of the statement: 500; after 60 days: -1, unlimited), and is never more than the disputed amount
facts.gold: 084 412.88 on a $412.88 charge reported late · 086 500 on $625 reported late · 50 on charges since the last statement
facts.passage: doc 031 'Reported within 2 business days of statement: Maximum liability $50' / 'Reported within 60 days of statement: Maximum liability $500'; the tool's description: 'based on Regulation E reporting timing rules and the disputed amount. Use -1 for unlimited liability.'

facts.fact: transaction_type is decided from how the card was used (pin_purchase in store with a PIN, signature_purchase in store with a signature, online_purchase, atm_withdrawal, atm_deposit, recurring_payment, person_to_person), and the agent asks when neither the customer nor the record says which
facts.passage: doc 031 arg 9 'Determine from user circumstances. Must be exactly one of: ...'

facts.fact: provisional_credit_eligible is true only when all four conditions hold (reported within 60 days of the statement, a category among unauthorized_transaction, card_present_fraud, card_not_present_fraud, atm_cash_discrepancy and duplicate_charge, a written statement, an open account); it is false for incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_received, recurring_charge_after_cancellation and atm_deposit_not_credited, and when the customer shared their PIN
facts.gold: 084, 086 incorrect_amount false · 083, 086 goods false · 086 deposit false · 082, 083 yes_shared false
facts.passage: doc 032 'Provisional Credit is REQUIRED when ALL of these conditions are met' and 'NOT REQUIRED ... when'

facts.fact: card_action follows the category mapping: close_and_reissue for card_present_fraud and card_not_present_fraud, freeze_pending_investigation for unauthorized_transaction, keep_active for every other category
facts.gold: 084, 086, 087, 088 fraud close_and_reissue · 083 unauthorized_transaction freeze_pending_investigation · the rest keep_active
facts.passage: doc 031 'Card Action Mapping by Dispute Category'

facts.fact: pin_compromised is the customer's answer to whether their PIN may have been compromised: yes_shared when they shared it, yes_observed when they believe it was seen or skimmed, no when it was not, unknown when they are unsure
facts.gold: 084, 086 fraud unknown · 082, 083 yes_shared · the rest no

facts.fact: contacted_merchant is the customer's answer to whether they tried to resolve it with the merchant, asked for non-fraud disputes (incorrect_amount, goods not received, a recurring charge after cancellation)
facts.gold: 084, 086 incorrect_amount true · 083, 086 goods true · 082 recurring true

facts.fact: a charge the customer denies, made in store with a card they still hold (a cloned or skimmed card, for example after a chip or CVV mismatch), is card_present_fraud, not card_not_present_fraud: the job says what to do when the customer still has their card, since 'card was physically present' can otherwise be read as the customer's own card; card_not_present_fraud is for online or phone transactions
facts.gold: 088 card_present_fraud on an in-store charge, card in the customer's hand
facts.passage: doc 031 'use card_present_fraud (for in-store/physical transactions) or card_not_present_fraud (for online/phone transactions)'

facts.fact: one dispute is filed for each transaction the customer disputes (the earliest of duplicates), and none for a transaction the customer has not disowned
facts.passage: doc 031 'Dispute the earliest (first) transaction when multiple duplicates exist'; each dispute is filed on its own transaction_id
